question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is option 3) i.e. '**on**'. 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context of the sentence is the date of birth of Mahatma Gandhi.
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most preposition to fill the blank is ‘on'.
 
• Use of 'on'- to denote when a thing is touching the surface of a place; to denote dates and days. 
 
• Another example:
 
 
• *​Ramesh will visit the zoo on Sunday with his family.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

 

Correct Sentence:__ *Mahatma Gandhi was born __**on**__ 2 October 1869...*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Let's look at the use of other options: 

 
 

 Preposition
 Usage
 
 
 
 

 **from**
 used to show the place where someone or something starts; used to show the material of which something is made; to show a change in the state of someone or something
 
 

 **of**
 used to indicate relating to, belonging to; to indicate reference; to specify the number or an amount 
 
 

 **in**
 
 
used to denote when something is inside another thing; to denote unspecified times, months, years, and seasons
